name: Cursor Teams

price.note: Per seat. Premium seats $30, Super $100, Ultra $200. Tiers can be mixed on one team.

meters.label: Weekly pool
meters.hint: Grok 4.5 to 4.7 and Composer 2.5, shared with the Grok apps

reset.rule: Resets once a week. The next reset time is shown under Usage at grok.com/dashboard and in Cursor's settings.
stipulations: Covers Grok 4.7, Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5 and Composer 2.5. Third-party models never draw from it.
One pool is shared by Agent in the editor, the CLI, Cloud Agents, Grok Bot and the Grok apps.
Each model drains the pool at a different rate. Cursor doesn't publish the pool size or the rates.
Each paid seat has its own pool. Seats don't share usage and it can't move between members.
A Super seat's pool is 3.75x a Premium seat's. An Ultra seat's is 12.5x.
The reset isn't at a fixed weekday or hour. It falls 7 days after you joined the plan (third-party report, unconfirmed).
quota-board's Cursor collector doesn't read this pool yet. Enter readings by hand from the dashboard.

overage: Usage past a seat's weekly pool, and all third-party model usage, is paid from the team's shared prepaid balance. Admins set one monthly additional usage limit for the team, a default per-member limit and per-member overrides. When a limit is hit, paid usage pauses for that member even if credit remains; included weekly usage keeps working. Paid usage also stops when the balance runs out. Only admins can change limits or Auto Top-up.

how: Each seat gets its own weekly pool for Cursor's own models (Grok 4.5 to 4.7, Composer 2.5), sized by the seat tier.
With Cursor Router on, Auto offers Balance and Intelligence modes. They bill at the routed model's price: Cursor models from the pool, third-party models from the prepaid balance.
Cost mode bills as a Cursor-model request and draws from the weekly pool whatever model serves it.
ext: Third-party models are billed at API list price plus a Cursor Token Rate of $0.25 per 1M tokens, from the prepaid balance.
The Token Rate doesn't apply to Cursor models, Cost mode, or third-party models whose cache-read price is under $0.10 per 1M tokens on every tier.
Requests with your own API key can still carry the Token Rate on Teams.
quirks: Teams created before the change keep legacy Standard ($40) or Premium ($120) seats with two monthly pools and on-demand usage on by default. They switch at cursor.com/unify/team.
Bugbot reviews on Teams are charged from paid usage, not the weekly pool.
Only Enterprise pools usage across seats.
quota-board can't tell a team seat's tier from the collector yet.

modelTable.title: Cursor models: pay-as-you-go rates past the weekly pool
modelTable.note: These models draw from the weekly pool first. Cursor doesn't publish how fast each one drains the pool. Past the pool, prepaid credit pays these rates per 1M tokens.
modelTable.footer: Grok 4.7 input over 256k tokens is billed at 2x, up to 500k. Fast long context is 3x.

events.what: Gemini 4 Carbon intro pricing ends. From 1 Dec it costs $4 in, $0.20 cache read, $20 out per 1M tokens.
